changes: Car menus now use BMW native pages, buttons, fonts, red selection and controller focus.
All menu resources load before entry. Failed or timed-out page changes recover to the main menu.
iDrive video has a separate page. Use BMW Back or tap the picture to return to native settings.
HUD and cluster sessions no longer run a custom iDrive menu renderer or controller grab.
JPEG decoding copies each output chunk once, avoiding repeated large frame-buffer allocations.
JPEG uses one capture clock and burst-tolerant recovery. Its requested rate no longer falls to 15 fps.
Hardware capture requests real-time encoder priority and the selected operating rate.
Diagnostics show phone capture, phone send and car received fps separately, plus video traffic.
BMW display, picture size, video, guide, update notes, test and reset controls remain available.
Update both apps to 0.7.0. Actual car frame rate and native menu presentation still need testing.
Removed QR pairing from both apps. Pair once with the phone address/code; the link is remembered.
Added a connection guide in both apps: BMW Wi-Fi, its menu and password, phone setup, audio and pairing.
The phone guide has shortcuts to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth settings.
Hardware video now adapts its bitrate to audio use and measured link congestion.
Hardware capture uses the display canvas when supported, reducing work and traffic without cropping.
Added a real encoder frame-rate cap so high-refresh phones do not send more frames than requested.
Late hardware-video queues skip to a fresh keyframe instead of building up delayed playback.
JPEG congestion handling tries smaller compressed frames before reducing the frame rate.
The QR connection helper is no longer required or offered by the current source.
Update both apps to 0.6.0. Audio coexistence still needs testing on the car.
Fixed the Store source listing so Connect, GPU Video and Display60 are available to install.
The Store can now find and install the helpers required by HUD Mirror automatically.
Car installation fix only. The Android 0.5.0 phone app stays compatible and needs no update.
GPU-drawn full-width iDrive interface replaces slow full-screen bitmap uploads.
Larger text, transparent two-line Max Mods logo, and clear selected/active phone buttons.
Trusted phone pairing is saved privately. Start on the phone to auto-start the selected display.
Display choice and layout are remembered after closing the app.
Choose one screen: HUD, instrument cluster, or iDrive. OEM BMW menus select display and layout.
Added the FrontCCU controller input and native focus-button fallback used by the Store app.
QR now tries matching local car addresses and waits for the connection helper to become ready.
Added the changing powertrain CRC feed and genuine subscription refresh for quiet Park fields.
Optional hardware AVC uses a separate installed Waze GPU decoder session, with JPEG fallback.
Test selected display and Force close are available. Closing releases only this app and its video.
Bluetooth/Android Auto audio, whole-phone fit, Compact/Full and live Park checks remain.
Added connection diagnostics, received fps, signal ages, last issue and a linked-phone reconnect button.
Start now shows a cancellable connection state. Compatibility mode changes apply immediately.
Update both apps to 0.5.0. GPU output and screen behaviour still need testing in the car.
New Max Mods dashboard, official logo and clearer Connection, Display and Updates pages.
JPEG video replaces bulky raw frames. Full capture detail stays fixed when the link slows.
Phone profiles: Sharp targets 30 fps at 768 x 432; Smooth targets 60 fps at 576 x 324.
Optional Display60 lifts the renderer clock to 60 fps. Actual projector speed needs a car test.
Choose the HUD or the instrument cluster map area. Compact leaves room below for BMW displays.
Keep mirroring on other iDrive pages, including Android Auto, while stationary in Park.
Pair with a car QR and phone scanner. Optional Max Mods Connect handles the car firewall.
The whole phone picture fits. Live Park checks and the 10-minute session limit still apply.
Max Mods iDrive Apps branding prepares this source for more apps.
Sound uses BMW Bluetooth media; video stays on Wi-Fi.
Auto reduces video load on a congested Bluetooth/Wi-Fi link, targeting up to 30 fps.
Phone video modes: Auto, Bluetooth priority and Quality priority. Detail/fps may adapt.
Phone shows Wi-Fi band and Bluetooth output availability without changing audio routing.
Brief video link failures retry up to three times. Stop and live Park checks still apply.
Connect Bluetooth media first, then open HUD Mirror. Update both apps to 0.3.0.
Continuous stream targeting 30 fps; the app shows the received frame rate.
Sharper 768 x 432 picture; the whole phone screen fits without cropping.
Portrait and landscape sizing follows phone rotation.
HUD size switches between Compact and Full screen. Compact leaves space below for BMW.
Fixed false stops on still screens; capture and connection health are checked separately.
Update both apps to 0.2.0. Actual HUD fps and BMW speed/sign visibility need a car check.
Fixed installation requests for unsupported BMW gear getters.
Subscribed to both Park-signal variants and displayed vehicle setup errors.
Initial parked HUD test and Android screen-mirroring prototype.
Local pairing, Stop controls and live stationary/Park checks.
